skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic interpretation techniques in both consecutive and simultaneous interpretation.
Demonstrate proficiency in listening, understanding, and translating between English and Vietnamese.
Expand vocabulary and terminology in various fields such as culture, politics, education, and environment.
Develop effective note-taking skills for interpretation tasks.
Foster self-study habits and lifelong learning attitudes.
Understand and adhere to professional ethics and responsibilities in interpretation.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and interpret complex information.
Work effectively in groups to enhance interpretation skills.
Manage time efficiently to complete interpretation tasks.
Communicate effectively in both written and spoken forms.
